Sustainable585: Issue #1 — Where Spring Begins

The first Sustainable585 dispatch: a recurring environmental roundup focused on the greater Rochester region.

  • Original publication LinkedIn

View original on LinkedIn ↗

About this work

The first Sustainable585 issue establishes a recurring environmental dispatch for the greater Rochester region. Its purpose is to make local research, policy, projects, and community work easier to discover and understand in one place.

Establishing the format

Paul defined the geographic focus, selected a manageable set of developments, and created a concise explanatory voice that could continue across later issues. The series begins in spring, using seasonal change as a natural point of entry into regional environmental work.

Why a regional lens helps

National climate coverage can obscure the organizations, waterways, decisions, and projects closest to a reader. Sustainable585 narrows the frame so that environmental communication becomes more specific and locally useful.

Paul’s role

Paul created, researched, wrote, and published the Sustainable585 series independently.

Publication note

This is an original PaulWrites project page documenting the assignment, editorial approach, and Paul’s contribution. It does not reproduce the complete external publication; use the source link to read the published article.
